screen.britannia_mod.bank.status.balance: The teller sets down the quill. "Thy account cannot hold that much of one coin. Withdraw some first, and I shall take the rest."
screen.britannia_mod.bank.status.invento: The teller looks over the counter. "Thy pack is full -- make room, and I shall hand it over."
screen.britannia_mod.bank.status.ineligi: The teller slides it back across the counter. "The bank will not keep that, I'm afraid."
screen.britannia_mod.bank.status.bank_ca: The teller weighs it in one hand. "Thy vault cannot bear the weight of that. Withdraw something first, and I shall find room."
screen.britannia_mod.bank.status.stored_: The teller peers into the vault. "That item is no longer here -- perhaps thou hast already withdrawn it."
screen.britannia_mod.bank.status.uncerta: The teller is taking longer than usual. Thy request may yet complete -- thy balance will show the truth of it.
